english translation text: ON THE FLOOR OF THE MAJLIS, FATIMA ZEHRA

arabic text: Farshe majlis pe fatema zehra\nLamha lamha shumaar karti hai
english translation text: Upon the floor of the majlis, Fatima Zehra\nKeeps count, moment by moment

arabic text: Ai azaadaro aao majlis me\nFatema intezar karti hai
english translation text: O mourners, come to the majlis\nFatima is waiting for you

arabic text: Ai azaadaro suno kehrahi hai saiyada
english translation text: O mourners, listen to what the Lady is saying

arabic text: Har ek chahne wale ko bakshwa dungi\nMere husain ko rote raho dua dungi
english translation text: I shall have every devotee forgiven\nKeep weeping for my Husain and I shall bless you with prayers

arabic text:
Tum apne gharme azakhana jab sajaoge
Jaza rasul se iski zarur paoge
Khuda bhi razi rahega ali bhi aur mai bhi
Gham apna bhul ke aashur jab manaoge
Tumhare dil ki har ek zakhm ki dawa dungi
english translation text:
When you adorn a house of mourning in your home
You will surely receive its reward from the Prophet
God will be pleased, and so will Ali, and so will I
When you forget your own sorrows and commemorate Ashura
I shall give a cure for every wound of your heart

arabic text:
Khabibi maut se dar ne nahi azadaro
Azaa ki raa se hat na nahi azadaro
Hussaini azme dikha te raho yazido ko
Hussainiyat se batakna nahi azadaro
Jo rahe hur hai usi pe thume chala dungi
english translation text:
My beloved mourners, do not fear death
Do not turn away from the path of mourning, O mourners
Keep showing Husaini resolve to the Yazids
Do not stray from the way of Husain, O mourners
I shall set you upon the very path of Hurr

arabic text:
Ajeeb haal se aungi mai sare mehshar
Ke laungi maii waha goud me husain ka sar
Mai laungi mere abbas ke kate hue hath
To saath lasha e asghar bhi aur hasan ka jigar
Khuda se baba ki ummat ko bakshwa dungi
english translation text:
In a strange state shall I arrive on the plain of Judgement
For I shall bring there, in my lap, the head of Husain
I shall bring the severed arms of my Abbas
Along with the body of Asghar and the liver of Hasan
I shall have my father's nation forgiven by God

arabic text:
Aur alam utawo ghamo se nijaat pawonge
Kaza be samne ho to hayat pawonge
Na juk saga na juka mera bawafaa ka alam
Isi alam ne wasila nijaat pawonge
Baroze hashre alam ki thume hawa dungi
english translation text:
And raise the alam — you will find relief from sorrows
Even if death stands before you, you will find life
It never bowed — the standard of my faithful one never bowed
Through this very standard you will attain salvation
On the Day of Judgement I shall let the standard fly for you

arabic text:
Ba waqt e asr gulu e husain kat ta tha
Pisar ke gird phiri ruh e fatema zehra
Nida e fatema aati thi aah wawaila
Ke chakki peeske maine husain ko paala
Karo na qatl ise mai tumhe dua dungi
english translation text:
At the hour of Asr, as the throat of Husain was being cut
The soul of Fatima Zehra circled around her son
The cry of Fatima rose in anguish and lament:
'I raised Husain by grinding the millstone
Do not kill him, and I shall bless you with prayers'

arabic text:
Meri sakina o zainab ki sab kaneezei sune
Wasiyat meri hai ye dhyan me rakhei
Kabhi ho zikr jo zainab ki beridai ka
To ek lamha bhi khud ko wo berida na karei
Mai tumko betiya zainab si ba haya dungi
english translation text:
Let all the handmaids of my Sakina and Zainab listen
This is my testament — keep it in mind:
Whenever the unveiling of Zainab is mentioned
Let them not remain unveiled even for a moment
I shall grant you daughters as modest as Zainab

arabic text:
Tum is jahaa'n me hamara sahara banjao
Hamari baai'se izzat to banke dikhlao
Na aisa ho kabhi apne kisi amal se kahi
Azaa ki ruh ko nuksaan tum na pohchao
Ye mera waada hai mai tumko bakshwa dungi
english translation text:
Become our support in this world
Show yourselves to be a source of our honour
Let it never be that through any deed of yours
You bring harm to the spirit of mourning
This is my promise: I shall have you forgiven
